description: This is the main startup class for the OFBiz server, implementing a thread-safe state machine and singleton pattern to manage server lifecycle commands such as start, stop, status, and help.

classes.name: Start
classes.description: Main class managing the startup, shutdown, and status of the OFBiz server with singleton pattern and thread-safe state management.

classes.name: ServerState
classes.description: Enum representing server states: STARTING, RUNNING, STOPPING.

classes.name: CommandType
classes.description: Enum for command types: HELP, STATUS, SHUTDOWN, START, with logic to determine command type from command list.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing OFBiz commands like start, stop, status, or help.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Start class.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the server and exits the application.
